subject: Recovered-client normal-health Tizzik Gi rifle kill and mission transition

Boss placement 198659 retained its deployed analogue 1000 health, 100 armor and normal attacks. Live services and databases were not modified.
setup.character: Copied level-2 Alden was positioned at (93.2,115.0,137.5), yaw 2.4529311656951904, with mission 1994 cave objective 2 complete and boss objective 1 active. This is a diagnostic checkpoint, not normal camp-to-boss travel.
setup.inputs: The original client loaded normally; H drew the crate rifle. Relative mouse movement of 200, 200 and 160 pixels turned the camera until the Tizzik Gi target panel appeared. Normal left-mouse fire was held 1200 ms immediately after the last turn. No GM attack or health edit was used.

observations.finding: The client selected Tizzik Gi, sent StartAutoFire, consumed two rifle rounds (20/980 to 18/980), and displayed a 106-damage number. The server logged two player hits against boss placement 198659, each 106 damage: first armor 100->0 and health 1000->994, second health 994->888. The boss remained alive, and the objective tracker still showed Boss Eliminated 0/1.

The earlier 560-pixel aim selected Tizzik Gi, but the client cleared its target before a later 4.8-second firing hold. All seven shots were sent at entity 0. This was a moving-target and input-timing miss, not evidence that the boss cannot be damaged.

Mission 1994 objective 1 remained active, objective 2 complete, and the copied SQLite database passed integrity_check. This probe did not complete the boss encounter or test reward and turn-in on normal stats.

A fresh copied normal-stat checkpoint used one continuous original-client mouse-down and eight 80-pixel left camera turns while Tizzik moved. Eleven consecutive player rifle hits, each logged as 106 damage, killed placement 198659: armor 100->0 on the first hit, then health 1000->0. The native client displayed 124 XP and 50 credits and changed the tracker to Report in to Captain Youngblood. It continued firing into entity 0 after the kill until mouse-up, ending with 2/980 visible rounds.

The saved character changed from 3571 XP/310 credits to 3695 XP/360 credits. Mission 1994 objective 1 is complete, objective 3 active, objectives 2 and 4 complete, and the copied database passes integrity_check. The client remained alive in the final capture. Youngblood conversation and mission turn-in were not exercised in this run.

observations.source_location: run 24 youngblood-second-click.png, capture-flag-complete.png, and copied char.db after process stop
observations.finding: From the run-17 post-kill saved character, a fresh normal client login showed Youngblood's objective marker. A short sideways step and normal mouse aiming exposed the interact prompt, and the second right-click opened his original-client Objective Completion dialogue. Continuing and completing the mission saved 1994 as state 4 with all four objectives complete, 8695 XP and 360 credits. The delta since boss kill was 5000 XP and zero credits; SQLite integrity_check returned ok. This continuation did not alter boss or ambient combat stats.

assessment: The deployed-derived server and original compatibility client support an ordinary rifle kill of the normal-health boss, persist the 1994/1->1994/3 transition, and reconnect for Youngblood's conversation and mission 1994 turn-in. This verifies emulator functionality only. The boss's health, armor, damage, level, spawn location and AI values remain reconstructed analogues or inferences; the original final-live fight and kill reward are unverified.
next_verification: Continue from a normal camp-to-cave route and compare boss behavior, survivability, allied participation and rewards with additional original final-live footage or captures. Do not infer retail boss statistics from this emulator-only fight.
